DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE = '9999-12-31';

IF @DATETOPROCESS = '9999-12-31'
BEGIN
    SELECT @DATETOPROCESS = CRM_DATE
    FROM EDS.EDS_CTL;
END;


WITH CUST AS
(
    SELECT
        ORGKEY,
        CUSTOMER_TYPE,
        CUST_FIRST_NAME,
        CUST_MIDDLE_NAME,
        CUST_LAST_NAME,
        NAMESUFFIX,
        TMDATE,
        GENERALTAXID
    FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM
    WHERE CUSTOMER_TYPE IN ('Retail', 'Corporate')
      AND @DATETOPROCESS >= SCD_START_DATE
      AND @DATETOPROCESS <= SCD_END_DATE

),

ADR AS
(
    SELECT
        ORGKEY,
        COUNTRY
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ORGKEY,
            COUNTRY,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY ORGKEY
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN ADDRESSCATEGORY IN
                             ('Home', 'Head Office')
                            THEN 1
                        WHEN ADDRESSCATEGORY = 'Present'
                            THEN 2
                        ELSE 3
                    END
            ) AS RN
        FROM EDS.CRM_ADDRESS
        WHERE ADDRESSCATEGORY IN
        (
            'Home',
            'Head Office',
            'Present'
        )
        AND @DATETOPROCESS >= SCD_START_DATE
        AND @DATETOPROCESS <= SCD_END_DATE
    ) A
    WHERE RN = 1
),

CORP AS
(
    SELECT
        CORP_KEY,
        CORPORATE_NAME,
        LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE,
        TAXID,
        REGISTRATION_NUMBER,
        SUBSECTOR,
        LINE_OF_ACTIVITY_DESC
    FROM EDS.CRM_CORPORATE
    WHERE @DATETOPROCESS >= SCD_START_DATE
      AND @DATETOPROCESS <= SCD_END_DATE
),

FIN AS
(
    SELECT
        ORGKEY,
        STR7
    FROM EDS.CRM_FINANCIAL
    WHERE @DATETOPROCESS >= SCD_START_DATE
      AND @DATETOPROCESS <= SCD_END_DATE
),

ETR AS
(
    SELECT
        CHILDCIFID,
        PARENTCIFID
    FROM EDS.CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP
    WHERE RELATIONSHIP = 'SUBSIDIARY'
      AND ORGKEY LIKE 'C%'
)

SELECT DISTINCT

    CUST.ORGKEY AS [id],

    CASE
        WHEN CBCSUB.[CODE] IS NOT NULL 
            THEN CBCSUB.[CODE]
        ELSE CUST.ORGKEY
    END AS [cptyOrgUnitId],

    CUST.ORGKEY AS [customerId],

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CONCAT(CUST.CUST_FIRST_NAME, ' ', CUST.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, ' ', CUST.CUST_LAST_NAME, ' ', CUST.NAMESUFFIX, ' ')
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.CORPORATE_NAME
        ELSE NULL
    END AS [name],

    RRACTRY.[ISO Code - 3] AS lkupResidence,

    RRACSEC.[MAP Counterparty Sector] AS lkupSector,

    SZE.Code AS lkupSize,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN ETR.PARENTCIFID
        ELSE NULL
    END AS parentId,
    
    'FCBS' AS custom1,

    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(CUST.TMDATE AS DATE), 101) AS custom2,

    NULL AS custom3,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CUST.GENERALTAXID

        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.TAXID
    END AS TINId,

    CASE
        WHEN CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE NOT IN (61, 62)
            THEN CORP.REGISTRATION_NUMBER
    END AS SECId,

    CASE
        WHEN CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE IN (61, 62)
            THEN CORP.REGISTRATION_NUMBER
    END AS DTIId,

    -- COALESCE(
    --     PSIC.[SUB-CLASS],
    --     CORP.SUBSECTOR
    -- ) AS lkUpPSIC,
    CORP.SUBSECTOR AS lkUpPSIC,

    -- CASE
    --     WHEN BNK.LEGAL_ENTITY_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    --         THEN 1
    --     ELSE RRACPT.[FCBS CODE]
    -- END AS lkupCounterpartyType,
    RRACPT.[MAP Counterparty Sector] AS lkupCounterpartyType,

    CORP.LINE_OF_ACTIVITY_DESC AS mainBusinessDescription,

    BNK.BANK_NAME_LOOKUP AS lkUpBankName,

    BNK.MAP_PH_BANK_SECTOR AS lkUpPHBankSector,

    ORG.Code AS lkupOrganisationCode,

    PHYN.Code AS lkupIsQuasiBankingFunction,

    NULL AS lkupPHBusinessUnit,

    NULL AS lkupLGUType,

    CASE 
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN BNK.LEGAL_ENTITY_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE = 43
                    THEN 'trustDepartment'
                WHEN BNK.LEGAL_ENTITY_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE <> 43
                    THEN 'bankProper'
                ELSE 'na'
            END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS lkupDepartmentType,

    NULL AS lkupRealEstateActivityType,

    NULL AS lkupIsMicrocredit
FROM CUST

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_CBCSUBSIDIARY CBCSUB
    ON CBCSUB.[FCBS CIF ID] = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN ETR
    ON ETR.CHILDCIFID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN ADR
    ON ADR.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_COUNTRY RRACTRY
    ON RRACTRY.[ISO Code - 2] = ADR.COUNTRY

LEFT JOIN CORP
    ON CORP.CORP_KEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_CPTYSECTOR RRACSEC
    ON RRACSEC.[FCBS CODE] =
        CASE
            WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
               THEN 51
            ELSE CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE
        END

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_PSIC PSIC
    ON PSIC.[SUB-CLASS] = CORP.SUBSECTOR

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_BANKNAMES BNK
    ON BNK.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_CPTYTYPE RRACPT
    ON RRACPT.[FCBS CODE] = 
        CASE
           WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
               THEN 51
           ELSE CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE
        END

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_NBQB NBQB
    ON NBQB.[FCBS CIF ID] = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_PHYN PHYN
    ON PHYN.[Code] = NBQB.[Code]

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_PHORGANIZATION ORG
    ON ORG.[FCBS CODE] = CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE_CODE
    OR ORG.[FCBS CIF ID] = CORP.CORP_KEY

LEFT JOIN FIN
    ON FIN.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_RRA_CPTYSIZE SZE
    ON SZE.[FCBS DESCRIPTION] = FIN.STR7;
